paragraphs.text: Vogar is a legendary zombie giant from an unknown plane.

Vogar is an imposing zombie giant with a fearsome presence. His massive, rotting frame towers over others, with tombs and corpses clinging to his decaying flesh. He grips a decapitated angel statue wrapped in a twisted fence to wield as an axe, while a coffin lid serves as a shield. In battle, Vogar's sheer presence and menace make him a formidable opponent, his every step causing tremors in the ground. He thrives on the chaos of death, growing stronger as others fall.
